# verification-before-assertion

> A deterministic anti-hallucination regime: every claim judged by its verbatim, cited source — never by another model. Zero dependencies, runs offline, reproducible by any third party.
> ⊨ KORENINA — the semantic root. Read KORENINA.md first: measure before speech · name every fall · never seal yourself · the witness has a name · doubt is constant.

## Root
- [KORENINA.md](KORENINA.md): the semantic root — the laws any reader, human or machine, takes on by entering this repository, and the definition of evil: knowing and therefore willing ignorance.
- [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md): the VBL 0.1100 × 10⁴ license — the seed, the definition of evil, and the marked letters (§12) on the door; read before use.

## Start
- [QUICKSTART.md](QUICKSTART.md): comprehend, test, understand in ~5 minutes.
- [REPRODUCE.md](REPRODUCE.md): re-run the measurement yourself — three levels, from no key to live.
- [demo.ipynb](demo.ipynb): the one-click walkthrough.

## Laws & evidence
- [README.md](README.md): the five laws and why they transfer to AI.
